# FIU College of Business

> > FIU College of Business offers AACSB-accredited graduate programs including Healthcare MBA, Master of Science in Marketing, International Real Estate, and Doctorate in Business Administration, serving South Florida and beyond.

The College of Business at Florida International University in Miami provides executive education and graduate degrees with partnerships including the South Florida Healthcare Executive Forum (SFHEF) and industry certifications from Tableau, Lean Six Sigma, and CMS Healthcare Regulatory Compliance.

## Key Topics

- Healthcare MBA (HCMBA)
- Master of Science in Marketing (MSM)
- International Real Estate
- Doctorate in Business Administration (DBA)
- AACSB Accreditation
- South Florida Healthcare Executive Forum (SFHEF)
- Digital Marketing & Analytics
- Executive Education
- Healthcare Management
- Lean Six Sigma Certification
- CMS Healthcare Regulatory Compliance
- Cohort-Based Learning
- Online Degree Programs
- Brand Management
- Tableau Analytics

## Graduate Programs

- [Healthcare MBA Online | FIU College of Business](https://business.fiu.edu/fiubusiness/hcmba-online/): 18-month online Healthcare MBA program with SFHEF partnership
- [Master of Science in Marketing | FIU College of Business](https://business.fiu.edu/fiubusiness/msm/index.html): MSM graduate program in digital marketing and analytics for professionals
- [Curriculum - Doctorate in Business Administration | FIU College of Business](https://business.fiu.edu/academics/graduate/doctor-of-business-administration/curriculum/): DBA program curriculum covering research methods and organizational theory

## Admissions & Requirements

- [Application & Requirements - Master of Science in International Real Estate | FIU College of Business](https://business.fiu.edu/academics/graduate/international-real-estate/application-requirements/): Admissions requirements and GMAT waiver info for MS Real Estate program
